breath_bed: a frightened man breathing shakily and quietly right next to a camcorder microphone, uneven breaths, trying to stay quiet, loopable
near_breath: slow, deep, calm breathing of someone standing right against a microphone, very close and intimate, long inhales and exhales, unhurried, not scared, no voice, loopable
handling: a camcorder microphone rubbed and knocked by a hand as the camera is spun around fast
vcr_clunk: a 1990s VCR jog shuttle control: one hard mechanical clunk and a quick whir of the tape heads
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
gasp: one short sharp frightened gasp of a man very close to a microphone, a quick intake of breath, no words
cam_hit: something heavy slamming against a plastic security camera housing on a ceiling bracket, recorded by the camera's own tiny microphone: one dull heavy thump right on the microphone, a hard plastic crack and the metal bracket rattling, close, no voice
duct_hum: a narrow concrete service corridor behind a shopping mall at night: a low steady ventilation duct hum and a faint electrical buzz, no people, no music, loopable
paper: a large folded paper floor plan being unfolded and handled close to a microphone, crisp paper rustle, no voices
step: one single footstep of a work boot on a hard polished stone floor in a large empty hall, close, with a short echo
office_hum: a small windowless security office at night: the faint high whine of several old CRT monitors, a low steady air vent hum, very quiet room tone, no people, no music, loopable
pen_write: a ballpoint pen writing steadily on the paper page of a notebook lying on a wooden desk, close to a microphone, scratchy pen strokes and small taps, no voices, no music
pen_fast: a ballpoint pen scribbling very fast and very hard on a notebook page on a wooden desk, frantic scratching strokes pressing into the paper, close to a microphone, no voices, no music
page_rip: a pen stabbing down and ripping violently through a notebook page on a desk, one loud sharp paper tear and a hard knock on the wood, very close to a microphone, no voices
chair_creak: an old office swivel chair creaking as a man sits down in it, springs and a squeak, close, no voices
page_turn: one notebook page turned and smoothed flat by a hand, close to a microphone, soft paper sound, no voices
